user.title: Track launches from a site
user.description: Reads Launch Library 2 (thespacedevs.com), filtered to launches at or near the site you name below.

data.upcoming_count: How many upcoming matching launches to track
data.near_window_hours: Switch to live polling this many hours before launch

data_description.site_filter: Case-insensitive text matched against the launch pad's location name, e.g. "Vandenberg" or "Cape Canaveral". Leave blank to track all launches worldwide.
data_description.api_key: A free Launch Library 2 API key raises the request-rate ceiling above the 15/hour unauthenticated limit. Leave blank to use the free tier.
data_description.near_window_hours: Inside this window, polling speeds up to the live interval below.
data_description.near_interval_minutes: How often to poll once inside the live window.
data_description.far_interval_minutes: How often to poll the rest of the time. Kept comfortably inside the free-tier rate limit by default.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Launch Library 2 with these settings. Check the site filter and API key, then try again.

abort.already_configured: A tracker for this site filter already exists.
